additions.site_name: Google Ireland Grange Castle data-centre campus, Grange Castle Business Park South, Dublin
additions.name: Google Dublin — existing DC1 and DC2 campus operations
additions.site_identity_review: The inspector identifies the two operating centres on this campus as DC1 and DC2 and places both outside the application for DC3. The site register already uses its published location as a campus locator for all three.

status.summary: Google’s November 16 customer disclosure confirms data-centre operations in Ireland. Google lists Dublin as its only Irish location. The planning inspector identifies its existing operating facilities there as DC1 and DC2.

locator.identity_review: The inspector identifies the two operating centres on this campus as DC1 and DC2 and places both outside the application for DC3. The site register already uses its published location as a campus locator for all three.

additions.distinctness_review: The one 195 site contains only the project permitted for DC3. The signed planning report identifies established DC1 and DC2 separately. This single operations project covers the two existing facilities on the same physical campus.
additions.successor_review: The amended planning decision grants permission for DC3. The operator’s November service declaration and campus directory support continuing operation of its established facilities.

additions.site_name: OrionStellar Data Center, Orion City IT Park
additions.name: OrionStellar Colombo — existing colocation operations

status.summary: On September 2, OrionStellar identified its Colombo data center and shared its commercial offer for server hosting and colocation at the facility.

locator.method: Native OpenStreetMap address point for Orion City, matched by property name, street number, street, postcode and the estate’s web domain.
locator.precision: Representative address point for the Orion City IT Park host property. The specific data-center building within the park is unspecified.
locator.identity_review: The certifier places the data center inside Orion City IT Park at the exact address that the estate and operator publish. The map feature identifies the host estate at this address.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The map source supplies no numerical horizontal accuracy for this address point.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 195 has no Sri Lankan physical site or project and no OrionStellar or Colombo imported aliases. The operator, certification body, and estate identify one facility on the host property.
additions.successor_review: The operator names its Colombo facility in the September 2 post. The operator profile continues to identify the commercial services at Orion City, and the facility certification remains associated with this property at review.

additions.site_name: Reliable Tech Park Data Centre, Airoli
additions.site_identity_review: The award identifies Yotta TB2 at Reliable Tech Park, Airoli. ESDS separately identifies its own facility at the shared commercial property.
additions.name: Yotta TB2 at Reliable Tech Park, Airoli

status.summary: The November 20, 2026 constructed-facility renewal attests to the completed condition of Yotta TB2 at Reliable Tech Park.

locator.identity_review: The award identifies Yotta TB2 at Reliable Tech Park, Airoli. ESDS separately identifies its own facility at the shared commercial property. The inherited OpenStreetMap point represents the host property.

additions.distinctness_review: The 195 campus has one ESDS project. Its statutory prospectus and the TIA award identify separate facilities within the same host property. Yotta identifies TB2 by name in its portfolio.
additions.successor_review: The scheme owner’s November register records this three-year constructed-facility renewal, with expiry in 2029. Its earlier award expired the previous day.

operating_model_updates.identity_review: Google identifies the Dublin centre as its own established infrastructure at Profile Park.
